blocks.x: Every AI-assisted output passes this checklist before it reaches a customer, an employee, or any file. It takes under a minute. Print it and keep it where the work happens.
If any item in Section A fails, do not send. Fix it or escalate it. There is no exception for being busy.

head: Check
Pass
rows: No price, rate, hourly figure or total appears anywhere unless an authorised person put it there.
No statement that anything is or is not code-compliant.
No statement about whether a permit is or is not required.
No statement that anything is safe, unsafe, hazardous or dangerous.
No instruction telling a customer to shut off, reset, bleed, bypass or operate anything.
No promise of an outcome, a lifespan, or that a problem will not recur.
No admission of fault, liability, negligence or defective work.
Nothing appears that was not in the source material. No invented facts.

head: Check
Pass
rows: Address correct, checked against the job record.
Equipment make, model and location match the record.
Dates and times correct, including the year.
Every measurement and specification matches the technician's note exactly.
Warranty terms quoted match the written warranty word for word.
Every part named was actually used, per the confirmed parts list.
Any figure carried over from another document is copied, not recalculated.

head: Check
Pass
rows: Nothing marked NOT RECORDED, CLARIFY or UNCLEAR remains unresolved.
Exclusions listed are the ones that apply to this job, not generic boilerplate.
Next step is stated, with who does it and by when.
Contact details are correct and monitored.

head: Check
Pass
rows: Sounds like our business, not like a template.
No pressure, urgency or scarcity that is not genuinely true.
No jargon left unexplained for a residential customer.
Nothing that would embarrass us if it were screenshotted and posted publicly.

head: Check
Pass
rows: No customer payment details were entered into an AI tool.
No government identification, date of birth or financial account data was entered.
No confidential business record, employee record or supplier agreement was entered.
Where personal information was necessary, only the minimum was used.

blocks.x: Escalate rather than send whenever an item touches gas, electrical hazard, water damage in progress, injury, a customer alleging damage, or anything outside your licence scope.
